blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Kitchen Renovation Cost in Burwood in 2026?
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover realistic kitchen renovation costs for Burwood homeowners, from budget refreshes to full custom builds with premium finishes and modern appliances.
body: If you are a Burwood homeowner wondering how much a kitchen renovation will cost in 2026, you are not alone. Kitchen renovations remain one of the most popular home improvement projects across Melbourne's eastern suburbs, and Burwood is no exception. The cost of a kitchen renovation in Burwood can vary dramatically depending on the size of your kitchen, the materials you choose, the complexity of the design and whether you are doing a cosmetic refresh or a complete structural overhaul. At H&H Cabinets, we have been building kitchens in Burwood for over 50 years, and in this guide we will break down exactly what you can expect to pay.

The single biggest cost factor in any Burwood kitchen renovation is the cabinetry itself, typically accounting for 40 to 50 percent of your total budget. Custom-built cabinets manufactured locally in our Burwood workshop will cost more than flat-pack alternatives, but the difference in quality, fit and longevity is enormous. Premium hardware such as Blum drawer systems and soft-close hinges, which we include as standard, add to the upfront cost but deliver a lifetime of reliable performance. For a standard Burwood kitchen measuring around 12 to 15 square metres, expect cabinetry costs to range from $5,000 to $10,000 depending on the configuration and finishes selected.

Benchtops represent the second largest expense in a kitchen renovation and the material choice dramatically affects both appearance and price. In Melbourne's eastern suburbs including Burwood, popular options range from laminate benchtops starting around $400 per linear metre through to engineered stone at $800 to $1,500 per linear metre and natural marble or granite exceeding $2,000 per linear metre. Our Burwood clients frequently choose engineered stone because it offers an excellent balance of durability, stain resistance and visual appeal without the maintenance demands of natural stone. The benchtop for a typical Burwood kitchen with an island will usually require 4 to 6 linear metres of material.

Labour and installation costs in Burwood typically represent 20 to 30 percent of your total kitchen renovation budget. As registered builders, H&H Cabinets handles all aspects of the installation process including plumbing, electrical rough-ins, tiling and the final cabinetry fit-out. Labour rates in Melbourne's eastern suburbs generally range from $60 to $100 per hour for qualified trades, and a complete kitchen installation in Burwood usually takes two to four weeks depending on complexity. We strongly recommend budgeting an additional 10 to 15 percent for unexpected structural issues that commonly arise when walls are moved or old flooring is removed in Burwood homes.

Melbourne's unique climate presents specific considerations for Burwood kitchen renovations that homeowners should not overlook. Burwood sits in Melbourne's eastern corridor where winter temperatures can drop below 5 degrees and summer highs regularly exceed 35 degrees. These temperature extremes mean your cabinetry must be built from materials that expand and contract without warping. At H&H Cabinets we use moisture-resistant substrates that meet strict Australian ECO-friendly standards, specifically chosen to handle Melbourne's notoriously unpredictable weather patterns. Proper ventilation planning around ovens and dishwashers is also critical to prevent heat damage to surrounding cabinetry during Burwood's hot summer months.

For Burwood homeowners considering a kitchen renovation, timing can significantly affect both cost and availability. The busiest period for kitchen renovations in Melbourne's eastern suburbs runs from September through to March, when trades are in highest demand and lead times can stretch to eight or twelve weeks. Booking your Burwood kitchen project during the quieter winter months of June through August can sometimes mean faster turnaround times and more flexible scheduling. Regardless of timing, always obtain at least three quotes from licensed cabinet makers and verify their credentials with HIA, ACFA or KBDi before committing to any kitchen renovation in Burwood.

One of the most common mistakes Burwood homeowners make is underestimating the total cost by focusing only on visible elements like cabinet doors and benchtops while forgetting about internal fittings, lighting, plumbing connections, electrical work and waste removal. A truly accurate kitchen renovation budget in Burwood should account for every component from demolition through to the final clean. At H&H Cabinets we provide comprehensive fixed-price quotes that itemise every element so there are no nasty surprises during your renovation. We also help Burwood clients prioritise their wish list so they can achieve the best possible outcome within their realistic budget.

If you are ready to find out exactly what your Burwood kitchen renovation will cost, the best next step is to book a free in-home consultation with H&H Cabinets. Our design team will visit your Burwood home, take precise measurements, discuss your vision and provide a detailed fixed-price quote, all at no cost and with absolutely no obligation. With over 50 years of experience, a 10-year workmanship warranty and hundreds of happy Burwood clients, we are confident we can deliver a kitchen that exceeds your expectations. Call us on +61 3 9808 4200 to schedule your free consultation today.

blogPosts.title: Why Burwood Homeowners Are Choosing Custom Cabinets Over Flat-Pack in 2026
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn why custom-built cabinetry from a local Burwood cabinet maker delivers better value, quality and longevity than off-the-shelf flat-pack alternatives.
body: The debate between custom cabinetry and flat-pack alternatives has intensified in 2026 as Burwood homeowners increasingly weigh upfront cost against long-term value. While flat-pack options from big-box retailers might seem like a budget-friendly shortcut, the reality for Burwood homes is far more nuanced. Every kitchen has unique dimensions, plumbing positions, electrical layouts and structural quirks that mass-produced cabinets simply cannot accommodate. At H&H Cabinets, we have been building custom cabinetry in our Burwood workshop for over 50 years, and we see first-hand the difference that purpose-built cabinetry makes compared to a one-size-fits-all approach.

The fundamental problem with flat-pack cabinetry for Burwood homes is that it assumes standard dimensions. Most Burwood houses, particularly the older weatherboard and brick veneer homes in the 3125 postcode, have walls that are not perfectly plumb, floors that are not perfectly level and ceiling heights that vary room to room. Custom cabinetry manufactured locally by H&H Cabinets is built to fit your specific Burwood kitchen measurements with millimetre precision. This means no unsightly gaps, no awkward fillers and no wasted space. Every centimetre of your Burwood kitchen is utilised efficiently, which is especially valuable in compact galley-style kitchens common throughout the suburb.

Material quality is where custom cabinetry from a Burwood cabinet maker truly separates itself from flat-pack alternatives. Flat-pack cabinets typically use thin particleboard with melamine surfaces that chip, swell and delaminate within a few years, particularly in Melbourne's humid summer months. In contrast, H&H Cabinets uses Australian-made substrates that meet strict ECO-friendly standards, combined with premium Blum drawer systems and soft-close hinges that come with a manufacturer's lifetime warranty. For Burwood homeowners planning to stay in their homes long-term, the superior materials in custom cabinetry represent dramatically better value over the life of the kitchen.

The installation process is another critical distinction between custom and flat-pack that Burwood homeowners should understand carefully. Flat-pack installation relies on you or a hired hand following generic instructions designed for a cabinet that may not actually fit your space. Custom installation by H&H Cabinets involves our experienced Burwood-based tradespeople who understand Melbourne building codes, handle all necessary plumbing and electrical connections and ensure every cabinet is level, secure and perfectly aligned. As registered builders, we also carry full insurance and provide a 10-year workmanship warranty, protections that simply do not exist with a flat-pack installation.

From a design perspective, custom cabinetry gives Burwood homeowners complete creative freedom that flat-pack simply cannot match. When you choose H&H Cabinets for your Burwood kitchen, our design team works with you to create cabinetry that reflects your personal style, complements your home's architecture and incorporates the specific storage solutions your family needs. Whether you want a waterfall island bench in engineered stone, integrated LED strip lighting, pull-out pantry systems or a custom breakfast bar, every element is designed and manufactured to your exact specifications. This level of personalisation is impossible with standardised flat-pack ranges.

The environmental argument for custom cabinetry also resonates strongly with Burwood homeowners in 2026. Flat-pack cabinets manufactured overseas and shipped to Australia carry a significant carbon footprint, and when they inevitably deteriorate after five to ten years, they end up in landfill. H&H Cabinets sources Australian-made materials that meet ECO-friendly standards, manufactures locally in our Burwood workshop and builds cabinetry designed to last decades rather than years. For environmentally conscious families in Burwood's 3125 postcode, choosing custom local cabinetry is the more sustainable option by a considerable margin.

Let us talk about the real cost comparison that Burwood homeowners need to consider. While a flat-pack kitchen might have a lower sticker price, the total cost of ownership tells a different story. Factor in the cost of professional assembly, the purchase of additional tools, the risk of installation errors requiring expensive fixes and the likelihood of replacing inferior cabinets within ten years, and the financial advantage of flat-pack evaporates quickly. Custom cabinetry from H&H Cabinets in Burwood is built to last 20 to 30 years or more, making the per-year cost of ownership significantly lower despite the higher initial investment.

If you are a Burwood homeowner weighing up your kitchen cabinetry options, we encourage you to visit our workshop at 5 Florence Street, Burwood to see and feel the difference between custom and flat-pack materials. Our design team can show you samples, discuss your budget and provide a free no-obligation quote for custom cabinetry tailored to your Burwood home. With over 50 years of experience and hundreds of satisfied clients across Melbourne's eastern suburbs, H&H Cabinets is the Burwood cabinet maker that delivers genuine quality, every single time.

blogPosts.title: The Complete Guide to Full House Cabinetry Renovations in Burwood
blogPosts.excerpt: Everything Burwood homeowners need to know about planning a full house cabinetry project, from kitchen through to wardrobes, laundry and living areas.
body: A full house cabinetry renovation is one of the most transformative investments a Burwood homeowner can make. Rather than upgrading your kitchen in isolation and living with mismatched cabinetry throughout the rest of your home, a whole-house approach delivers a cohesive, beautifully integrated interior that elevates every room. At H&H Cabinets, we have been completing full house cabinetry projects for Burwood families for over 50 years, and in this comprehensive guide we will walk you through everything you need to know about planning, budgeting and executing a whole-home cabinetry renovation in Melbourne's eastern suburbs.

The first step in any full house cabinetry project in Burwood is a thorough in-home consultation where our design team assesses every room that requires new cabinetry. This typically includes the kitchen, bathrooms, laundry, bedrooms with built-in wardrobes, home office spaces and living areas with entertainment units or display cabinets. During this consultation we measure every space precisely, discuss your family's specific storage needs, review material and colour options and identify any structural considerations unique to your Burwood home. This comprehensive approach ensures that the final design is both aesthetically consistent and practically optimised for how your family actually lives.

Planning is the most critical phase of a full house cabinetry project and getting it right can save Burwood homeowners thousands of dollars and weeks of construction time. Unlike a standalone kitchen renovation, a whole-home project requires careful sequencing to minimise disruption to your family. At H&H Cabinets we typically recommend tackling the project in stages, starting with the kitchen as the most complex area, then moving to bathrooms and laundry, followed by bedrooms and living spaces. This phased approach allows your family to maintain use of at least some functional rooms throughout the renovation and helps manage the budget across multiple stages.

For Burwood homeowners, the cost of a full house cabinetry renovation varies significantly based on the size of your home, the number of rooms involved, the materials selected and the complexity of the designs. A typical Burwood home with a kitchen, two bathrooms, laundry, three bedrooms with built-in wardrobes and a living room entertainment unit can expect to invest between $40,000 and $80,000 for quality custom cabinetry manufactured and installed by registered builders. While this represents a substantial investment, the per-room cost is significantly lower than tackling each room separately due to efficiencies in design, material purchasing and installation scheduling.

One of the greatest advantages of choosing H&H Cabinets for your full house Burwood project is that we handle everything under one roof. As registered builders with HIA, ACFA and KBDi memberships, we coordinate all trades including plumbing, electrical, plastering and tiling. This single-point-of-responsibility model eliminates the coordination headaches that Burwood homeowners face when engaging separate trades for each room. It also means consistent quality control throughout your entire home, one unified design vision and the backing of a single 10-year workmanship warranty covering every piece of cabinetry in your Burwood property.

Material selection across a full house project requires careful thought to ensure consistency while allowing each room to have its own character. For Burwood homes, we typically recommend selecting a primary colour palette and material range that flows through all rooms while varying hardware, handles and accent details to differentiate spaces. Melbourne's eastern suburbs experience a wide temperature range throughout the year, so all materials must meet Australian standards for dimensional stability and moisture resistance. Our Burwood workshop stocks a comprehensive range of ECO-friendly substrates, laminates, timber veneers and solid timber options that we can show you during the design consultation.

The timeline for a full house cabinetry renovation in Burwood typically ranges from six to twelve weeks depending on the scope of work and the size of your home. During this period our installation team works systematically through each room, maintaining clean and organised work areas at all times. We understand that Burwood families often have children and pets, so we take extra care to minimise dust, noise and disruption during the construction phase. Many of our Burwood clients choose to stay with family or friends during the most intensive weeks of the renovation, particularly during the kitchen installation phase when cooking facilities are temporarily unavailable.

If you are a Burwood homeowner considering a full house cabinetry renovation, the best time to start planning is now. Our design calendar fills quickly, particularly during the busy spring and summer months, so early engagement ensures availability when you need it. Contact H&H Cabinets on +61 3 9808 4200 to book your free in-home consultation. Our team will visit your Burwood property, assess every room and provide a detailed staged quote that breaks down costs room by room. With over 50 years of experience delivering whole-home cabinetry solutions, we are the Burwood cabinet maker trusted by families who demand nothing less than exceptional quality throughout their entire home.

blogPosts.title: Best Cabinet Materials for Melbourne Homes: A Burwood Homeowner's Guide
blogPosts.excerpt: A detailed comparison of cabinet materials suited to Melbourne's climate, helping Burwood homeowners choose the right substrates, doors and finishes for longevity.
body: Choosing the right cabinet materials for your Burwood kitchen or cabinetry project is one of the most important decisions you will make during the renovation process. Melbourne's variable climate, with hot dry summers, cold damp winters and everything in between, places unique demands on cabinetry materials that homeowners in milder climates never need to consider. At H&H Cabinets, our Burwood workshop has tested and refined material selections over more than 50 years to ensure every kitchen and cabinetry project we deliver withstands Melbourne's challenging conditions while looking beautiful for decades. This guide explains the most important material considerations for Burwood homeowners.

The cabinet carcass, the internal structural box that forms the backbone of every cabinet, is the foundation of your entire kitchen and the material choice here matters enormously for Burwood homes. Medium-density fibreboard (MDF) and particleboard are the most common substrates, but they are not created equal. Standard particleboard absorbs moisture and swells, making it unsuitable for Melbourne's humid summer conditions. H&H Cabinets exclusively uses moisture-resistant substrates that meet strict Australian ECO-friendly standards, providing Burwood homeowners with cabinetry that maintains its structural integrity regardless of seasonal humidity fluctuations in Melbourne's eastern suburbs.

Cabinet door materials define the visual character of your Burwood kitchen and the options range from affordable melamine through to premium solid timber. Thermofoil doors offer a smooth, modern finish at a mid-range price point and are well-suited to Melbourne's climate because they resist moisture absorption. Two-pack painted doors provide a luxurious, seamless finish that is highly popular in contemporary Burwood kitchens. For a natural aesthetic, timber veneer doors showcase real wood grain while being more dimensionally stable than solid timber. At H&H Cabinets, our Burwood showroom displays all these options so you can see and touch each material before committing to your kitchen design.

Benchtop material selection for Burwood kitchens requires balancing aesthetics, durability, maintenance requirements and budget. Laminate benchtops remain the most affordable option and modern laminates have improved dramatically in both appearance and resilience. Engineered stone such as Caesarstone or Silestone has become the most popular choice in Melbourne's eastern suburbs because it offers exceptional stain resistance, scratch resistance and colour consistency. Natural stone options including marble and granite provide unmatched visual beauty but require regular sealing and more careful maintenance. For Burwood families who cook frequently, engineered stone consistently delivers the best combination of beauty and practicality.

Hardware selection is often overlooked by Burwood homeowners but it fundamentally determines how your cabinets perform over time. The hinges and drawer systems in your kitchen will be opened and closed tens of thousands of times over their lifespan, so quality here is non-negotiable. H&H Cabinets uses exclusively Blum hardware throughout our Burwood installations, an Austrian manufacturer that offers a lifetime warranty on their products. Blum soft-close hinges prevent cabinet doors from slamming, Blum drawer runners provide smooth full-extension access and Blum lift systems make overhead cabinets effortlessly accessible. This premium hardware is a standard inclusion in every Burwood kitchen we build.

Melbourne's building regulations and Australian Standards impose specific requirements on cabinetry materials, particularly regarding formaldehyde emissions and fire resistance. All materials used in Burwood homes must comply with relevant Australian Standards including AS/NZS 1859 for wood-based panels. H&H Cabinets sources only materials that meet or exceed these standards, ensuring that your Burwood kitchen or cabinetry project is not only beautiful and durable but also safe for your family and environmentally responsible. Our ECO-friendly material commitment means lower formaldehyde emissions and sustainable sourcing practices that Burwood homeowners can feel genuinely good about.

For Burwood homeowners planning a cabinetry project, we strongly recommend visiting our workshop and showroom at 5 Florence Street, Burwood to explore material options in person. Seeing and touching materials under natural light gives you a far better understanding of colour, texture and quality than any website photograph or sample board. Our design team can walk you through the pros and cons of each material for your specific Burwood home, considering factors like kitchen orientation, natural light levels, family lifestyle and budget. This hands-on consultation experience is one of the reasons Burwood families have trusted H&H Cabinets for over 50 years.

Understanding cabinet materials empowers Burwood homeowners to make informed decisions that balance beauty, durability, safety and value. Whether you are renovating a single kitchen or planning a full house cabinetry project, the materials you choose will determine how your investment performs over the coming decades. At H&H Cabinets, we stand behind every material we use with our comprehensive 10-year workmanship warranty and the lifetime Blum hardware warranty that protects your investment long into the future. Contact our Burwood team on +61 3 9808 4200 to discuss which materials are best suited to your next project.
